metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the best strengthening exercises to help keep the lower back and hips strong and flexible. 

These exercises can be done daily, and may help give quick and long-lasting relief for back and hip pains, aches, and muscle tightness.

Let us know how they work for you!
